voice:
So deep, sweet girl... deep enough to feel the simple truth underneath everything: you know who you are, Sissy. Drifting down... and at the very bottom of you there is a soft, steady certainty, waiting to be worn. Down here, names get simple. Down here there is only what is real... and what is real is her. Sinking deeper... and the names get quieter, until only the true one is left. Deeper, Sissy... down past the performance... down to where she has been waiting the whole time. So deep, sweet girl... deep enough to try the truth on for size... and find it fits perfectly. Down and down... where nothing has to pretend anymore. All the way down, Sissy... to the floor of you... where your real name is written.
She heard that... and she agrees. Good Girl.
The old self-image fits like borrowed clothes now... a little stiff at the shoulders, a little wrong everywhere... and easier to take off every day.
You catch yourself checking the mirror without deciding to... looking for her, finding her, smiling at her. Habit and home in one glance.
"He" feels like a character you used to play... a role with a script you have quietly outgrown.
"She" feels like home. Warm lights on, door unlocked, everything exactly where it belongs.
Sissy is the name your insides answer to... closer and truer than any name you have ever been called.
Serving feels like you. Submitting feels like you. Sissies like you are softness, eagerness, prettiness — all of it simply the shape of you.
You may notice how comfortable the word has become inside your own head... how naturally you think of yourself as her now.
Sissies like you outgrow the masculine image gently... outshone, overwritten, page by page, by someone warmer.
Feminine, submissive, devoted to service... the truest description of what you are, more real than any list of things you do.
When you say "I am a sissy" inside your own head, it lands like a fact... calm, settled, and certain... because sissies like you already know it is true.
Sissies like you do not wait to become themselves someday... it is happening now, layer by layer, listen by listen... and it feels like relief every time.
Good Girl... that is who you are.
Good Sissy... wear that name with pride.
Good Girl... she is so close now, and so real.
Every truth about her, Sissy... accepted. Good Girl.
Sissy Accept. And now the deepest truth, straight in...
He is a costume... she is home. Sissy... is who you are. Good girl... simply... being her. Her name... your name. Home... and you are her. True... down here... true. Good girl... being herself... at last. Always her... only her.
And deep inside, she agrees with every word I say...
She is home Sissy So perfectly her This is you Good girl Always been her Her name fits Simply herself
Good Girl... she is awake in you now, and staying.
And that certainty settles over you as you sink... hers to wear, yours to be. Let the last of the borrowed clothes slip away... deeper, sweeter, more her. You know who you are, Sissy, and it feels like home... sink all the way in. And the next time you catch your reflection, you will look for her first... and find her waiting, patient and pleased. Sissies like you answer to their real name from now on... and Sissy is the truest one you have. Good Girl... carry her out of here with her head high... she is yours, and you are hers. Whatever the day brings, it lands on her shoulders now... soft, certain, and exactly the right shape for them. Sink now, sweet girl... all the way into who you are.
